title: pvProbeLocation
body:
## pvProbeLocation

Samples the input dataset at the points of a probe point cloud (ProbeType; ParaView 5.13.3 offers only the fixed-radius point source) and outputs those points as polydata with interpolated point data, the containing cell's cell data and a vtkValidPointMask array marking points that fell inside the data. Use it for values at a monitor location, and pvPlotDataOverTime after it for a time history. Use probeLine or pvPlotOverLine for profiles.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A probe outside the mesh, or in a region without cells, gets zero values with vtkValidPointMask 0; check the mask.
- ComputeTolerance (default true) derives the cell-search tolerance from the data; set an explicit Tolerance only if points on cell faces are missed.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ProbeLocation`. Identity: `filters/ProbePoint`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the dataset from which to obtain probe values. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ComputeTolerance` | Set whether to compute the tolerance or to use a user provided value. On by default. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PassFieldArrays` | Set whether to pass the field-data arrays from the Input i.e. the input providing the geometry to the output. On by default. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ProbeType` | This property specifies the dataset whose geometry will be used in determining positions to probe. | `{"type":"typed proxy","choices":["Fixed Radius Point Source"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `{"type":"Fixed Radius Point Source"}` |
| `Tolerance` | Set the tolerance to use for vtkDataSet::FindCell | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

### Nested `ProbeType` → `Fixed Radius Point Source`

Syntax: `{"type":"Fixed Radius Point Source","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `extended_sources/FixedRadiusPointSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ProbeType.options.Center` | Location [x, y, z] to probe, or the centre of the probe sphere when Radius is above 0. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `ProbeType.options.NumberOfPoints` | Number of probe points. With 1 and Radius 0 the data are sampled exactly at Center; larger counts place points at random inside the sphere, giving one output point per probe point. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ProbeType.options.Radius` | Radius of the sphere in which probe points are placed at random; 0 puts every point at Center. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvProbeLocation",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
